rule:
Every door must have a clear width of at least 900 mm.

Regulatory text (the authoritative clauses - use them to interpret the requirement and its applicability; you must still work out how to read or measure it from the IFC):
DIN 18040-1:2010-10 (Accessible buildings - publicly accessible buildings), 4.3.3.2 Dimensional requirements, Table 1 (paraphrased): all doors must provide a clear width of at least 90 cm.
Benchmark convention: the clear width of a door is its overall width (IfcDoor.OverallWidth) minus twice the lining thickness recorded in the IfcDoorLiningProperties of its door type. When the door type records no lining thickness, the clear width is the overall width. A door without a recorded overall width cannot be judged: label it ALERT, and do NOT report it as a violation.

Label every door.
Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcDoor) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.

solibri.configuration: SOL/208 Accessible Door Rule, sub-rule 404.2.2 reduced to clear width: Use spaces off; one requirement row * / * with min width 900 mm, min height 0, max threshold 99999 mm, min glazing 0 %, no free-area requirements; default frame and panel thickness 0; no property overrides. Role Get Started (the Schependomlaan report was made under Example Rules; no classification is used by this rule).

reference.status: Solibri SOL/208 issues reproduced from the IFC under the stated convention; disagreements adjudicated with reasons.
reference.policy: Clear width = OverallWidth - 2 x type LiningThickness (else OverallWidth) >= 900 mm with 0.5 mm tolerance.
reference.limitations: Solibri measures door geometry including the frame when no lining thickness is recorded; outcomes agree here, values may differ. The Solibri report was produced on the original buildingSMART Clinic_Architectural.ifc; this EC3 copy has the same doors (GUIDs, widths, lining) and reproduces it.
